$comment: AU services SMB posting profiles, version 2 (T-0121, design §4.4). Supersedes version 1 (au-services-smb-profiles.json) for new companies; companies set up with v1 keep their rows (DL-0340). Built on au-services-smb chart version 2 and au-gst version 2. Changes from v1 per the accountant-reviewer persona review (DL-0280 MAJORs 4-5, triage DL-0283): HARDWARE (resale) no longer capitalises into 1500 — its asset slot is empty, so the wizard gap step asks whether hardware is inventory or expensed on purchase — and its revenue is 4140 Hardware sales; new EQUIPMENT profile for own-use equipment (asset 1500, purchase tax code CAP); OVERSEAS_CUSTOMER has no default tax code, so a product without its own code is refused NO_TAX_CODE and a person codes the line (interim until ADR-0044, T-0122/T-0123). purchaseTaxCode is template data the wizard offers as the default tax code of products it creates under the profile; it is not stored on the profile (ADR-0044's product tax class is the stored form). Data, not code (design principle 3).
